getPokedex: query getPokedex { pokemon: pokemon { id name is_default stats: pokemonstats { stat_id base_stat } sprites: pokemonsprites { pixel: sprites(path: "front_default") default: sprites( path: "other[\"official-artwork\"].front_default" ) } types: pokemontypes { type: type { name } } specs: pokemonspecy { species_id: id is_legendary is_mythical generation_id evolution_chain_id evolves_from_species_id evolution_methods: pokemonevolutions { min_level min_happiness time_of_day trigger: evolutiontrigger { name } item: item { name } held: ItemByHeldItemId { name } move: move { name } location: location { name } } } } }
getPokemonInfo: query getPokemonInfo($id: Int!) { pokemon(where: { id: { _eq: $id } }) { height weight base_experience abilities: pokemonabilities(order_by: { slot: asc }) { is_hidden ability: ability { name effects: abilityeffecttexts( where: { language_id: { _eq: 9 } } ) { short_effect } } } cries: pokemoncries { cries } species: pokemonspecy { gender_rate capture_rate base_happiness hatch_counter habitat: pokemonhabitat { name } color: pokemoncolor { name } shape: pokemonshape { name } growth: growthrate { name } eggGroups: pokemonegggroups { group: egggroup { name } } genus: pokemonspeciesnames( where: { language_id: { _eq: 9 } } ) { genus } flavor: pokemonspeciesflavortexts( where: { language_id: { _eq: 9 } } order_by: { version_id: desc } ) { text: flavor_text version: version { name } } } } }
getTypeEfficacy: query getTypeEfficacy { efficacy: typeefficacy( where: { damage_type_id: { _lte: 18 } target_type_id: { _lte: 18 } } ) { damage_type_id target_type_id damage_factor } types: type(where: { id: { _lte: 18 } }) { id name } }
